name: Buckwheat
siboNotes: Naturally gluten-free and well-tolerated for SIBO diets. High fiber content may cause initial digestive adjustment.
preparationTips: Rinse raw buckwheat groats before cooking to remove bitter compounds
Toast groats in a dry pan for nuttier flavor before adding liquid
Cook with 2:1 water to buckwheat ratio for 15-20 minutes
Buckwheat flour works well in pancakes and baked goods as wheat substitute
nutritionalHighlights: Complete protein with all essential amino acids
Good source of fiber and B vitamins
Contains rutin, a flavonoid with antioxidant properties
